title: Lifted Trucks 2026 Year to Date

voiceover.text: Here's Lifted Trucks' year to date, January through September.
We've sold six thousand four hundred forty-five trucks, up thirty-seven percent on last year. And September was our biggest month yet, at seven hundred seventy-seven.
The footprint keeps growing. Five new stores opened this year, for eighteen dealerships, and Texas and Oklahoma now outsell Arizona.
Revenue reached five hundred nineteen million dollars, up forty percent, with about ten thousand seven hundred dollars of gross on every truck.
Adjusted EBITDA is sixteen point seven million, up thirty-six percent, and it's grown every quarter.
Demand is strong. Leads are up forty-four percent, to more than forty-two thousand.
Three things to watch. The newest stores are ramping slower than plan. Days supply is fifty-two, against a forty-five day goal. And Texas recon still takes about thirteen days.
Next year's plan calls for ten thousand four hundred trucks, and thirty-two million in EBITDA. Let's finish this year strong.
